# Buzz Off

> Buzz Off ("Quit Caffeine: Buzz Off" on the App Store) is an iPhone app that helps people quit caffeine cold turkey or cut back step by step with a weekly plan. Free to download, with an optional Pro subscription.

- Two ways to do it: Cold Turkey (stop now, a day counter and the 21-Day Reset) or Gradual (a weekly plan that lowers a daily caffeine target, in mg, from your own starting point).
- A short daily check-in (caffeine yes or no, drink, mood, optional symptoms) and quick-add drink logging with the caffeine in each drink.
- Day counter, streaks, money saved (based on what you usually spend), symptom trends and plan-adherence charts, a pledge, achievements and a daily reminder.
- Short reads on withdrawal, sleep and swaps, with sources listed in the app.
- iPhone only, in English.
- Buzz Off is a tracking and habit tool, not medical advice.

## Guides

Every figure in the guides links to its source (EFSA, FDA, NHS, USDA, peer-reviewed research).

- [Caffeine guides](https://buzzoffapp.com/guides/): all guides, by topic
- [How to quit caffeine](https://buzzoffapp.com/guides/how-to-quit-caffeine/): cold turkey or gradually, and what the first days are like
- [Caffeine withdrawal](https://buzzoffapp.com/guides/caffeine-withdrawal/): symptoms typically start 12–24 hours after the last caffeine and last 2–9 days (Juliano & Griffiths, 2004)
- [Caffeine withdrawal headache](https://buzzoffapp.com/guides/caffeine-withdrawal-headache/): how long it lasts, what may help, when to get help
- [Caffeine in drinks](https://buzzoffapp.com/guides/caffeine-in-drinks/): coffee, tea, cola, energy drinks and chocolate, from EFSA and the FDA
- [Caffeine in decaf](https://buzzoffapp.com/guides/caffeine-in-decaf/): decaf typically has 2 to 15 mg per 8 fl oz cup (FDA)
- [How long caffeine stays in your system](https://buzzoffapp.com/guides/how-long-does-caffeine-stay-in-your-system/): mean half-life about 5 hours, range 1.5 to 9.5 hours (National Academy of Sciences, 2001)
- [Caffeine and sleep](https://buzzoffapp.com/guides/caffeine-and-sleep/): when to stop caffeine before bed
- [Coffee swaps](https://buzzoffapp.com/guides/coffee-swaps/): decaf, tea and caffeine-free drinks
- [How to quit energy drinks](https://buzzoffapp.com/guides/how-to-quit-energy-drinks/): energy drinks generally have 54 to 328 mg of caffeine per 16 fl oz (FDA); cold turkey or cutting back
- [How to cut back on coffee](https://buzzoffapp.com/guides/how-to-cut-back-on-coffee/): smaller steps with half-caf, decaf and tea; in one study withdrawal appeared only once intake fell to 100 mg a day or less (Evans & Griffiths, 1999)
- [Tiredness after quitting caffeine](https://buzzoffapp.com/guides/tiredness-after-quitting-caffeine/): a confirmed withdrawal symptom; withdrawal typically lasts 2–9 days (Juliano & Griffiths, 2004)
- [Caffeine in tea](https://buzzoffapp.com/guides/caffeine-in-tea/): black tea about 50 mg per 220 ml cup (EFSA), green tea 37 mg per 12 fl oz (FDA), matcha by the gram (Meyer et al., 2023)
- [Afternoon slump without coffee](https://buzzoffapp.com/guides/afternoon-slump-without-coffee/): the post-lunch dip, short naps and a quick walk, from the research
- [Caffeine and anxiety](https://buzzoffapp.com/guides/caffeine-and-anxiety/): who may be more sensitive and how much is a lot, from FDA guidance and research

## Tools

Free tools that run in the browser; nothing entered is stored or sent. Each one shows its sources.

- [Caffeine tools](https://buzzoffapp.com/tools/): all tools
- [Caffeine calculator](https://buzzoffapp.com/tools/caffeine-calculator/): adds up the caffeine in today's drinks, from EFSA and FDA figures
- [When will my caffeine wear off?](https://buzzoffapp.com/tools/caffeine-wear-off-calculator/): estimates caffeine left at bedtime, using the 5-hour mean half-life and the 1.5 to 9.5 hour range (National Academy of Sciences, 2001)
- [Caffeine taper planner](https://buzzoffapp.com/tools/caffeine-taper-planner/): a 6-week plan with the same rule as the app's Gradual plan
- [Money saved calculator](https://buzzoffapp.com/tools/caffeine-money-saved-calculator/): what quitting or cutting back could save, from your own prices
